name: Stone Dodger [Selfless, Teamwork]
body:
By working with an ally to gauge the trajectory of incoming attacks, you can more easily avoid taking damage.

Benefit(s): As long as your allies are able to see and hear you, they receive a +4 dodge bonus to AC against attacks from hurled rocks (or projectiles of similar shape, including bludgeoning ranged attacks from siege weapons). If they are hit by such an attack while they have this bonus, your allies can attempt a Reflex save to take only half damage from the attack. The DC for this save is equal to the bonus of the ranged attack used to hurl the rock.
